text: Mass Obliteration is a legacy achievement rewarded for using the Obliterum Forge to obliterate 50 crafted items.
Master Alchemist is an Assassination rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Master Assassin (artifact trait), Bag of Tricks and Gushing Wound traits.
Master Assassin is an Assassination rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Urge to Kill, Shadow Swiftness, Master Alchemist and Gushing Wound traits.

Maryann Strossner is the voice of Granny Marl and Scrollsage Nola. She is 93 years old, and her prestations have become iconic among the community. Her Twitter feed was immediately overwhelmed by fans greeting her after she joined the social platform.
Masasa Moyo is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Mask of Artful Dodging can be obtained from the Large Plundered Sack or Small Coin Chest in the Hall of Shadows at a very low drop chance.
Master's Pot is provided as an objective for The Mile-High Grub.
Master Liew is a pandaren located in Deliverance Point in Broken Shore.
Master Longfang is a worgen rogue of the Uncrowned located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. He is in stealth standing next to Wiley the Black.
__NOTOC__ Master Artificer Nyell is a felborne located in Nyell's Workshop in Suramar.
Master Bu is a pandaren located at Morning Breeze Village in the Wandering Isle. Master Bu is the humanoid form of Ban-Lu, son of Xuen.
The Master Caravan Kodo is ridden by Balgor Whipshank during Mor'shan Caravan Delivery.
Master Gunner Prix is a gnome located at the Dead Man's Bay of Azsuna.

The Mass Grave, or the Mass Graves and the mass grave(s), is an area in Tirisfal Glades overrun with the Rot Hide gnolls. It was made to accommodate the massive number of deaths suffered in Tirisfal during the Third War. Deliah Andrean was buried here and the gnolls dug her and other bodies and took them to Fenris Isle in Silverpine Forest.
Massive Lakebeast was a riverbeast located in Tanaan Jungle. It was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
Massive Kyparite Core drops from Kypa'rak located at the Briny Muck in the Dread Wastes.
__NOTOC__ Masqued Revelers are nightborne located in Suramar.
Master Gunner Nahkek is a skeletal troll that wanders around a small area in the northwestern Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun.
Master Gunner Garna is a skeletal troll who wanders back and forth in the northwestern Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun alongside a Soulspitter Cobra.

Master Gunner Torwec is a skeletal troll who wanders along the western dock in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun. He holds the Idol of Sacrifice, one of the three idols that were used by Pirate-King Zem'lan to curse his crew into skeletons.

Master Bos'n Segazea is a skeletal troll standing on the shore between the western and central docks in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun alongside a Subdued Exile. She is seemingly overseeing the efforts of Jublaya Four-Fingers, Rigger Unjaazi, and Zalnon'mak, who are carrying crates onto the shore.

Master Bos'n Maalzahn is a skeletal troll overseeing a large underwater stash of crates between the western and central docks in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun. Jublaya Four-Fingers, Rigger Unjaazi, and Zalnon'mak transport crates between the stash and a smaller pile on the shore, while Rigger Balajai and Seshu the Slave carry crates between Maalzahn's stash and another pile farther out into the sea.
Master J. Capaldi is a deceased human buried at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar.
__NOTOC__ Maruk the Volcano is an ogre located in Molten Cay.
Master Cannoneer's Cloak is a quest reward from Hands Off My Booty!.
Massive Rockworm Fang drops from Slivermaw in Darktide Roost in .
Marwig Rustbolt is the goblin owner of Snuff Inc and the author of the manuals for Snufflenose Gophers.
The Master-At-Arms Wristguards are a reputation reward; you must be with the Proudmoore Admiralty to purchase this item from Provisioner Fray in Boralus for .

__NOTOC__ The Master's Promontory was a location in the Twisting Nether. It was reached through astral projection. Lord Illidan Stormrage, who reached it in the same way, could be found here. The Nether Crucible could be found next to him. It was a sanctuary area.
Master Harvester is a harvest golem that was taken out by Alliance champions.
The Mask of the Uncrowned is a quest reward from A Sheath For Every Blade. It can also be purchased from Kelsey Steelspark in the Hall of Shadows for .
The Mask of the Unseen Path is a quest reward from Walk This Way. It can also be purchased from Outfitter Reynolds in Trueshot Lodge for .
Massive Endurite Gyreworms are gyreworms located in Deepholm.
Masked Quartet is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all objectives in any Horrific Vision with any 4 Faceless Masks active.
Masked Trio is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all objectives in any Horrific Vision with any 3 Faceless Masks active.
Masked Duet is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all objectives in any Horrific Vision with any 2 Faceless Masks active.
Masked Soliloquy is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all objectives in any Horrific Vision with any Faceless Mask active.

Master Calligrapher is a quest achievement earned by Demonstrate complete mastery in each of Scrollsage Nola's calligraphy lessons by never deviating from the lines during the world quest, "Calligraphy."

Masked Sylvar are sylvar located at the Crumbled Ridge in Ardenweald.

Masked Infiltrators are necromancers disguised as Chosen Protectors in the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus. They can be sniffed out and revealed with the help of the Chosen Corpsehound during The Hills Have Eyes. __NOTOC__

Martyr's Breath was an Azerite trait available to Holy paladins.
Massive Crushers are charred behemoth located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Master Enchanter Theopolus is an individual who sent items via mail that the player didn't receive due to having full bags.

Massive Oxxein Tankards are looted from chests in Maldraxxus.

Massacred Grunts are dead orcs located in the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale and the Ruins of Auberdine and Bashal'Aran in Darkshore during the In Teldrassil's Shadow questline.
Massacred Skullcleavers are jungle trolls killed by Tyrande Whisperwind in Bashal'Aran in Darkshore during In Darkest Night.
The Mask of Spirits is an enchanted tiki located in Krazzlefrazz Outpost in Drustvar during Faction Assaults. It is part of the Tiki Army.
The Mask of Shadows is an enchanted tiki located in Krazzlefrazz Outpost in Drustvar during Faction Assaults. It is part of the Tiki Army.
Master Chef Graccu is a chef responsible for creating Graccu's Homemade Meat Pie and Graccu's Mince Meat Fruitcake.
Master Looter is a transport ship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

The Mask of Bwonsamdi is an enchanted tiki located in the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald. It is also found in the Other Side. The mask allows the adventurer to communicate with Bwonsamdi while he is trapped in the realm of Mueh'zala.

__NOTOC__ Marz is a Maldraxxi abomination who was created through Abominable Stitching by the Necrolord Covenant. He was once an ogre, whose soul was sent to Maldraxxus and became bound to this new abomination body that was given to him.

Maruu is a tuskarr child located in Kauriq Gleamlet in the Azure Span. He occasionally stops by Marootu or can be seen riding Oon.

Master of Deception is a Rogue talent located in the 1st tier of the Subtlety Tree. Each rank increases effectiveness.

Mastery: Ignite is the Fire Mage Mastery, improved by the mastery secondary stat. It applies a damage over time effect to targets hit by the mage's Fireball, Fire Blast, Scorch, Pyroblast, or Flamestrike, the target burns for additional damage over 9 seconds. Ignite also procs off Meteor and Phoenix Flames if the Mage is talented into these spells.
Matilda was Gerard's wife. They were robbed by Menag and his Bloodhill Bandits when Arthas Menethil was in Strahnbrad. Arthas killed Menag and gave the stolen object back to her husband Gerard.
Mastery: Master Demonologist is the Mastery for Demonology warlocks, improved by the mastery secondary stat. This mastery increases the damage done by the warlock's demons.

__NOTOC__ Mathiel is a night elf quest giver located in the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. While he originally did not have an anvil, he eventually was able to save up to purchase one from working on repair jobs for adventurers. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Master Mechanic Castpipe is a gnome quest giver located in Tinker Town in Ironforge.
Master Sergeant is a Legacy achievement awarded for reaching the rank of Master Sergeant in the pre-2.0 Honor system.

Master Sergeant Fizzlebolt is a gnome located at the Scarab Dais in Silithus alongside Field Marshal Snowfall during the Call of the Scarab micro-holiday. Fizzlebolt, along with his Horde counterpart Senior Sergeant Kai'jin, is a callback to the massive server-wide gathering quest needed to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Thankfully, rather than every kind of tradeskill reagent, Fizzlebolt only is looking for meat.
__NOTOC__ Master Nightsong was a night elf quest giver located in the Military Ward in Ironforge.
Master Vornal is a jungle troll located in Sen'jin Village in Durotar. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
Mataus the Wrathcaster is an undead at Tyr's Hand in the Eastern Plaguelands. He was formerly a level 60 elite quest giver at Light's Hope Chapel.

Matrix Punchograph 3005 is a fixed device located throughout Gnomeregan. There are five models: 3005-A, 3005-B, 3005-C, 3005-D and 3005-E. These devices were used in Data Rescue (removed in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm) and to train in certain Engineering schematics.
Material Assistance is the 1st quest in the Material Assistance quest chain.

Mastok Wrilehiss is an orc quest giver located at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. During the Fourth War, he defended the post when the night elves attacked it and was encountered by Alliance champions.

Master of Elements is a popular PvE talent for any talent build. It restores up to 15/30% of the mana cost of any spell that critically hits one or more targets (so AoE spells such as Flamestrike, Cone of Cold and Blast Wave are affected by this talent). Since most mages critically hit between 20 and 40% of the time this talent is equivalent to an effective mana cost reduction of all spells which can critically strike.
Master of Subtlety is a Subtlety rogue talent. It increases your damage done while Stealthed as well as for 6 seconds after Stealth is broken.
Master Sergeant Biggins is a gnome PvP accessories vendor located in the Champions' Hall in Stormwind.
__NOTOC__ Matron Arena is a blood elf priest trainer located at the Sunspire on the Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.
__NOTOC__ Mathreyn is a blood elf artisan skinning trainer located in a small camp west of the Shepherd's Gate in Eversong Woods. He supplies Sathein with hides.

Matis the Cruel is a wandering blood elf located on the road east from the Vector Coil in western Bloodmyst Isle. His capture is required for Matis the Cruel (quest). Matis is the lieutenant of the man'ari eredar Sironas, the commander of the Sunhawks — the blood elves who battled the draenei for control of the Exodar, and are now attempting to retake it. Upon finding Galaen's Journal and discovering that Matis was responsible for the torture of Vindicator Kuros's mentor —Vindicator Saruan— Vindicator Kuros gives the player a flare gun and a contingent of his finest hunters in order to capture Matis, who patrols from the Vector Coil. Matron is a title awarded to female characters for completing the For The Children achievement, related to the seasonal event Children's Week. Male characters who complete this achievement will be awarded the title Patron.
Mastery: Sniper Training is the mastery effect for Marksmanship hunters. It is improved by the mastery secondary stat.
__NOTOC__ The Mates of Magmothregar form the harem of Magmothregar and live with him and their offspring in the cave in Magmoth in the Borean Tundra.
Master of Arms is a Legacy achievement. Until Patch 4.0.1, weapon skills had to be leveled up similar to professions. As weapon skills have been removed, this achievement can no longer be obtained.
Master of Wintergrasp is a meta player vs. player achievement earned for completing the listed Wintergrasp achievements.

Master of Strand of the Ancients was a meta player vs. player achievement earned for completing all of the Strand of the Ancients PvP achievements. Required for Battlemaster (Horde) and Battlemaster (Alliance).
Master of Arathi Basin is a meta Player vs. Player achievement earned for completing all of the Arathi Basin PvP achievements. Required for Battlemaster (Alliance) / Battlemaster (Horde).

__NOTOC__ Masud is one of the challenges in the combat ring of Valhalas in Icecrown.

Master of Alterac Valley is a meta player vs. player achievement earned for completing all of the Alterac Valley PvP achievements. Required for Battlemaster (Alliance) / Battlemaster (Horde).
The Mastiff Whistle is provided as an objective for Leader of the Pack (quest). It summons a group of Attack Mastiffs.
The Mastiff Trainer's Vest is a quest reward from From the Shadows (quest).

Mastiffs are a breed of dogs found primarily in Lordaeron. They appear to be common pets and companions of human societies, including vrykul. While mostly found domesticated, wild mastiffs can also be found in Gilneas. The Alterac brewhound is a type of mastiff bred for rescue.
Matriarch-Hide Wristguards are a quest reward from the Mount Hyjal quest Death to the Broodmother.

Mastery: Harmony is the Mastery for Restoration druids, increased by the mastery secondary stat. It increases healing done for each druid-specific HoT effect on the target. Other HoT sources such as trinkets do not count.
Mastiff Trainer's Wand is a quest reward from From the Shadows (quest).
__NOTOC__ Matron Ossela is a blood elf priest trainer located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary in Dalaran.

Mastery: Critical Block is the Mastery of protection warriors, improved by the mastery secondary stat. It increases the warrior's chance to block and critically block incoming attacks. Critical block chance is a subset of 'normal' block chance. If a warrior has 50% block chance and 30% critical block chance it means that 15% of all attacks will be critically blocked and 35% will be 'normally' blocked.
Mastery: Master of Beasts is the mastery effect for Beast Mastery hunters. It increases the damage done by the hunter's pets, and is increased by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Essence of the Viper is the mastery of Survival Hunters, and is improved by the mastery secondary stat.

Echo of Light is the Mastery for Holy priests, improved by the mastery secondary stat. It causes almost all direct healing heals (see below) cast by the priest to also grant a Heal over Time (HoT) effect on the target.
Mastery: Frozen Heart is the Frost death knight Mastery. Its effect is increased by the mastery secondary stat.
Mastery: Blood Shield is the Blood death knight Mastery. Its effect is increased by the mastery secondary stat.
__NOTOC__ Master Tinker Trini is the gnome quartermaster for the Gnomeregan faction and is located in the Great Forge in Ironforge. She is mounted on a Gnomeregan Mechanostrider.

Mastery: Mana Adept is the Arcane mage Mastery, improved by the mastery stat. It is a unique gameplay mechanic for arcane mages that increase their damage the more mana they have in their mana pool. It requires that arcane mages utilize proper mana management in order to gain the most benefit from it.
Mastery: Unshackled Fury is the Mastery of Fury warriors. It increases the warrior's physical damage done while enraged and is improved by the mastery secondary stat.

Mastery: Illuminated Healing was the Mastery for Holy paladins, improved by the mastery secondary stat. It causes direct heals and their multistrikes cast by the paladins to also grant an absorb shield effect on the target. If a paladin refreshes an existing copy of their own Illuminated Healing on a target, the new absorption amount will be added into the old absorption amount and the duration will be reset. The total absorption created can never exceed 1/3 of the casting paladin's health.

Master of Twin Peaks is a meta player vs. player achievement earned for completing the Twin Peaks achievements. Two of the achievements differ depending on your faction. If you are Horde then you will need to complete I'm in the Black Lodge and Wild Hammering. Conversely if you are Alliance you will need to complete the counterpart achievements I'm in the White Lodge and Drag a Maw.

__NOTOC__ Master Tao Woodear is a pandaren food and drink vendor located by the Grill Counter at the Jade Temple Grounds in the Jade Forest. Occasionally, he can be seen preparing food in a nearby stove.

Master Stone Fist is a pandaren located at the Clarion Bell in the Jade Forest. He is said to be nearly unmatched in single combat. He once defeated nine hundred and ninety-nine challengers in a row, but according to him, the thousandth challenger, High Elder Cloudfall, cheated. In Tian Monastery, he is an instructor of sparring exercises, specializing in the art of one-on-one combat. His best student is Xiao, and he would have graduated him several times over, but Instructor Xann insists that he needs more discipline.
